facts.text: Evan injured his knee playing basketball with the kids last week, which has made it difficult for him to stay active.

evidence.quote: I had a setback last week - messed up my knee playing b-ball with the kids. It's been tough to stay active since.

facts.text: Evan is currently undergoing physical therapy and performing light exercises to maintain strength in his knee.

evidence.quote: PT has helped some. I can't do intense workouts, but I'm doing easy exercises to keep it strong.

facts.text: Evan mentioned that he recently helped a lost tourist find their way, which resulted in an unexpected city tour.

evidence.quote: You're not gonna believe this, I had a bit of an adventure recently. Helped a lost tourist find their way, and we ended up taking an unexpected tour around the city.
